name: bacheca
description: Bacheca universitaria — attività fra studenti (progetto SAW 2026)

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:modello && npm run dev --workspace web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:modello && npm run dev --workspace api
scripts.build: npm run build:modello && npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace api
scripts.test: npm run build:modello && npm run build:api && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:concorrenza: npm run build:modello && npm run build:api && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "node --test --test-name-pattern=concorrenza test/iscrizioni.test.mjs"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && firebase deploy --only hosting
